summary: Frontend-only test of the new collapsed 'menu box' navigation. CRITICAL: The claimed rewrite of /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx has NOT been applied. The file still contains the OLD horizontal pill-bar navigation (NAV.map -> NavLink pills inside <nav data-testid='primary-nav'>). None of the required new testids exist in the DOM: nav-menu-toggle, nav-panel, nav-backdrop are all absent. Verified live on https://sugarcane-insights.preview.emergentagent.com/ at viewport 1600x900 - the sticky pill nav row is still visible directly under the header and shows Overview / Mill-wise Analytics / Farmer Search / ... pills. Because the collapsed-menu UX is entirely missing, none of the 7 feature-test bullets (expand, collapse-on-second-click, collapse-on-route-change, backdrop, Escape, active highlight rgb(11,23,18)) can be evaluated. Existing individual nav-* links (nav-overview, nav-farmer-search, etc.) still work as before so route regression is not blocked, but the requested UX is completely absent.

action_items: Main agent must actually rewrite /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx: replace the sticky <nav data-testid='primary-nav'> pill row with (a) a single collapsed button in the header carrying data-testid='nav-menu-toggle' that shows current section icon+name plus a Menu/X icon, (b) an expanding panel with data-testid='nav-panel' inside the sticky header using a max-height transition, containing a responsive grid (5 cols desktop / 2 cols mobile) of 10 nav cards using existing testids (nav-overview, nav-mill-wise-analytics, nav-farmer-search, nav-mill-search, nav-arrear-tracker, nav-farmer-distress-index, nav-district-analytics, nav-sugar-ecosystem, nav-analytics-dashboard, nav-settings), (c) a full-viewport backdrop div with data-testid='nav-backdrop' that closes the panel on click, (d) React useState 'open' driven close on route change (useEffect on useLocation().pathname), Escape keydown, and toggle button re-click, and (e) active card style with backgroundColor rgb(11,23,18) and lime accent.
After the rewrite is committed, re-run this iteration to test toggle/backdrop/Escape/route-close/active-highlight/responsive-grid and regression on all 10 pages.
